Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

1.
Development Agreement Extension for Azusa Pacific University (APU) - The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding a request for an amendment to the Development Agreement with APU to allow for extension. The Development Agreement, which will expire in September 2025, implements the APU Specific Plan and secures development rights for the University while providing certain public benefits for the City. The proposed amendment does not change the terms of the DA other than to provide an extension, an EIR Addendum has been prepared for adoption.
F-1
2.
Development Code Amendment No. 256 ? Updated Telecommunications Facilities Regulations? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding a proposed ordinance related to Telecommunications Facilities. Chapter 88.46 (Telecommunication Facilities) was last substantively amended in 2010. Since then, changes in federal and state law?including various court decisions and Federal Communications Commission (FCC) orders and regulations?have placed significant procedural and substantive limits on the City?s exercise of local control over matters involving wireless communications facilities. This proposed ordinance (?Ordinance?) would amend Chapter 88 to comply with these changes in the law by repealing and replacing Ch. 88.46 and amending the definitions in Ch. 88.70. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3).
3.
Development Code Amendment No. 259 ? Establishing Planned Development Process ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding proposed amendments to incorporate a definition and regulations for a Planned Development process. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3).
